code_version_note: Git commit is execution base; per-file source hashes identify newly written, possibly uncommitted research code.

pooling_protocol.pool: 0.5 arithmetic mean plus 0.5 normalized geometric mean of three independently inner-selected family predictions; no fitted ensemble weights.
pooling_protocol.test: Use saved per-fold model predictions with matching fold-specific TE scope, then average the two seed-specific pooled test predictions. No replacement by full-data TE in existing models.
pooling_protocol.decision: Primary argmax; one alternative exact-log assignment assumes test class counts [1700,1700,1700], based on supplied competition context, not independently verified from test labels.
pooling_protocol.balanced_simulation: Per outer fold, draw equally many held-out rows per true class, fixed 5 repeats. Evaluate a fixed log-assignment rule. Labels construct the evaluation distribution and compute scores only, never fit scores/weights or feed the decoder. Overlapping repeats are descriptive, not independent replicates.
pooling_protocol.limitations: Component families' earlier OOF performance has been inspected; this combination is exploratory, not an unbiased independent confirmation. Do not call simulated Accuracy a measured Kaggle score. Latest user explicitly requests experimental submit-ready CSV.

scope: exploratory fixed hybrid pool of previously inspected component rules
